Fulfillment.description: Fulfillment details for a customer order

fulfillmentBusinessUnitId.description: Identifier for the business unit responsible for fulfillment.

shipmentTrackingNumber.description: Tracking number from external shipping provider

shipmentTrackingLink.description: Tracking link for external shipping provider

tenderLineItems.description: Tender line items for the fulfillment

pickupDatetime.description: Scheduled pickup datetime for the fulfillment.

userProfileId.description: User profile ID associated with the order.

projectId.description: Project identifier associated with the order.

orderCode.description: Short per-fulfillment order code minted by Customer Order. Present for PICKUP_IN_STORE and HOME_DELIVERY_FROM_STORE fulfillments only; absent for HOME_DELIVERY_FROM_WAREHOUSE and for fulfillments created before this field existed.

originModifiedDatetime.description: ISO 8601 time at which Customer Order produced this fulfillment state. The ordering-guard source for consumers of cor.public.event.store-fulfillments-updates.v2: compare it against the value stored for the same fulfillment and skip anything not strictly newer. Minted once per publishing operation, so every fulfillment published together shares one value — including a sync that both cancels one fulfillment and updates another. Not taken from the inbound payload, and never the Pub/Sub envelope publishTime, which a dead-letter replay re-mints. Millisecond precision: two publishes for one fulfillment inside the same millisecond are indistinguishable, and a strict-newer consumer skips the later one until the next publish. Raising precision here alone would not close that window, because the consumer compares with Date.parse, which truncates to milliseconds.

changedDateTime.description: Date and time when status changed.

lineItemId.description: The line item ID associated with this fulfillment.

itemId.description: Identifier for the product/item associated with the line item.

quantity.description: The quantity of the line item allocated to this fulfillment.

unitOfMeasure.description: The sales unit of measurement for the line item (UN/CEFACT code, e.g. EA, KGM).

readyForPickupDateTime.description: Date and time for when the item was ready for pickup

isSubstitutionAllowed.description: The customer's choice for this line: may the store substitute this item if it is out of stock? Absent when not set, which means substitution is allowed.
